verdicts.decision_note: The client explicitly establishes manual prize claiming, an implementation-relevant smart-contract and frontend behavior.
The client explicitly requires prize wins to be displayed on the Winners page and claimable through a one-click control.
The client explicitly identifies a material unresolved choice between automatic prize payout and a visible redemption control.
The client specifies automatic prize transfer to the winner's wallet, replacing the prior claim control and Winners-page claim surface.
The automatic-wallet-transfer decision resolves the earlier payout-versus-redemption uncertainty and returns the claim flow to active implementation.
The client again raises a material uncertainty about whether the $900 prize uses automatic payout or a redemption control.
In the uniquely bounded prize-claim exchange, the client accepts the redemption-control flow and its eligibility-window visibility; the payout-mode replacement leaves no stale conflicting key.
The accepted redemption-control behavior resolves the immediately preceding claim-method ambiguity.
This is the first target-specific implementation-completion claim after the client asks whether the prize-claim feature is done; it is not runtime verification.
